The same grant may be reused only for resumes against that same bound root until the cohort is COMPLETE or the Owner explicitly abandons and deletes the grant. maxProviderInvocationCount is the durable reservation ceiling under that single bound mission root. No technical expiry is required. Grant lifetime is operational: retain during resumptions; Owner deletes after COMPLETE or on explicit abandonment.
